title: Deer dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='26' ry='4' fill='#2a2f4a'/>
  <!-- back leg lifted -->
  <rect x='60' y='64' width='6' height='16' rx='3' fill='#a3612f' transform='rotate(20 63 72)'/>
  <rect x='63' y='78' width='6' height='6' rx='2' fill='#c98a52' transform='rotate(20 66 81)'/>
  <!-- front leg planted -->
  <rect x='34' y='64' width='6' height='26' rx='3' fill='#a3612f'/>
  <rect x='33' y='86' width='8' height='6' rx='2' fill='#c98a52'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='20' ry='13' fill='#c0763a'/>
  <!-- belly patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#f0d9a8'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='55' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#f0d9a8' transform='rotate(-20 70 55)'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='32' y='34' width='10' height='26' rx='5' fill='#c0763a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='30' rx='12' ry='10' fill='#c0763a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='20' rx='4' ry='7' fill='#a3612f' transform='rotate(-20 28 20)'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='20' rx='4' ry='7' fill='#a3612f' transform='rotate(20 45 20)'/>
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='21' rx='2' ry='4' fill='#f0d9a8' transform='rotate(-20 28 21)'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='21' rx='2' ry='4' fill='#f0d9a8' transform='rotate(20 45 21)'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='34' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#f0d9a8'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='28' r='2.2' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='36.7' cy='27.3' r='0.7' fill='#fff6e0'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='34' r='2' fill='#4a2a18'/>
  <!-- antlers -->
  <path d='M33 21 L30 12 L26 9 M30 14 L33 9 M40 21 L42 13 L46 10 M42 15 L40 10' stroke='#e8c07a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- raised front hoof arm -->
  <rect x='52' y='48' width='6' height='14' rx='3' fill='#c0763a' transform='rotate(-40 55 55)'/>
  <rect x='60' y='40' width='8' height='6' rx='2' fill='#f0d9a8' transform='rotate(-40 64 43)'/>
  <!-- music notes for dance -->
  <circle cx='78' cy='30' r='3' fill='#ffd75e'/>
  <rect x='79.5' y='18' width='2' height='12' fill='#ffd75e'/>
  <path d='M81.5 18 Q87 20 85 25' stroke='#ffd75e' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='22' r='2.5' fill='#ff8fb1'/>
  <rect x='69.3' y='12' width='1.8' height='10' fill='#ff8fb1'/>
</svg>
